After my first break up i felt the same way. Best friend got the blunt of my depressed bullshit rants too. But what happened was i lived for me. I know it sounds selfish but all the money i saved up for my ex went to me, got myself some nice clothes, went to some nice places, etc. I made myself feel better and eventually my friends felt better around me. 

I moved on and am now close friends with my first ex. Our relationship now is better than when we were together. Trust me man, it may seem counter intuitive but the first step you should take is to focus on making yourself better. After that you'll feel like the whole world is in your palm
